name: SpatialCourse_Crafter - Rathmines & Lake Macquarie Trails
description: Curated multi-stop spatial itineraries and courses originating from 21 Bournville Road, Rathmines NSW.

courses.title: Lake & Flying Boat Heritage Trail
courses.tagline: Wartime Catalina history, Dobell's art studio, and tranquil lake foreshores
courses.ideal_for: History buffs, art lovers, relaxed family strolls

stops.name: Start: 21 Bournville Road
stops.instruction: Depart 21 Bournville Rd and head east down Dorrington Road towards the lakeshore.

stops.name: Rathmines Park & WWII Catalina Flying Boat Base
stops.instruction: Explore the historic WWII flying boat hangars, memorial slipway, and waterfront walkway.

stops.name: Rathmines Bowling Club (Lunch & Barefoot Bowls)
stops.instruction: Stop for casual bistro dining overlooking Catalina Bay or roll a round of barefoot bowls.

stops.name: Wangi Wangi Foreshore Peninsula
stops.instruction: Drive around the western bay to Wangi peninsula for coffee or a waterfront stroll.

stops.name: Dobell House & Historic Studio
stops.instruction: Tour Sir William Dobell's preserved heritage cottage, painting studio, and original artworks.

stops.name: Wangi Point State Conservation Area (Final Sunset Stop)
stops.instruction: Conclude with an evening stroll through the red gum forest to Wangi Point lookout.

courses.title: Coastal Bluffs & Sea Caves Safari
courses.tagline: Dramatic red cliffs, historic mining jetty, low-tide caves, and 1903 lighthouse

stops.name: Start: 21 Bournville Road
stops.instruction: Head northeast via Toronto and the Pacific Highway towards the coastal coastline.

stops.name: Redhead Beach & Wooden Shark Tower
stops.instruction: Photograph the iconic timber shark tower and dramatic red sandstone cliffs.

stops.name: Caves Beach Sea Caves & Swansea Channel
stops.instruction: Time your visit for low tide to explore the spectacular network of carved sea caves.

stops.name: Catherine Hill Bay & Historic Coal Pier
stops.instruction: Walk the historic mining village and view the dramatic ocean coal loading jetty.

stops.name: Norah Head 1903 Lighthouse & Rockpools
stops.instruction: Ascend the headland for lighthouse tours, rockpool safaris, and whale watching.

courses.title: Gourmet & Hunter Valley Wine Country Escape
courses.tagline: Lakeside yacht club lunch, scenic country drive, and world-class Shiraz & Semillon
courses.ideal_for: Wine enthusiasts, foodies, celebratory days out

stops.name: Start: 21 Bournville Road
stops.instruction: Head north along the western lake route towards Toronto.

stops.name: Royal Motor Yacht Club (Toronto Marina Coffee & Vista)
stops.instruction: Begin the journey with morning espresso overlooking the sailing yachts at Toronto Marina.

stops.name: Hunter Valley Wine Country (Pokolbin & Lovedale)
stops.instruction: Arrive in Pokolbin for vineyard tastings, cheese pairings, and cellar door masterclasses.

courses.title: Rainforest Creeks & Singletrack Trail Quest
courses.tagline: Ancient moss walls, Boarding House Dam freshwater swimming, and Glenrock MTB trails
courses.ideal_for: Mountain bikers, trail runners, wilderness adventurers

stops.name: Start: 21 Bournville Road
stops.instruction: Head west into the rugged Watagan mountain ranges via Freemans Waterhole.

stops.name: Watagans NP: Boarding House Dam & 110m Moss Wall
stops.instruction: Hike the lush rainforest loop to the famous 110-metre moss-covered rock wall.

stops.name: Speers Point Park & Warners Bay (Post-Hike Refuel)
stops.instruction: Recharge with lakeside gourmet lunch along the lively Warners Bay cafe promenade.

stops.name: Glenrock State Conservation Area (Singletrack Trails)
stops.instruction: Tackle the world-class coastal singletrack MTB trails or bushwalk down to Glenrock Beach.
